items.original: Regulation-size indoor basketball court with six hoops and hardwood flooring, plus volleyball twice a week. Included with every GHF membership.

items.original: A regulation-size indoor basketball court with six basketball hoops and hardwood flooring — the perfect game, whether you are shooting alone or running full-court with friends.

items.original: Six days a week — weekdays 6:00–10:00am, and Sundays 11:00am–2:00pm.

items.original: Twice a week — Wednesdays 6:00–11:00pm and Sundays 5:00–10:00pm. The net goes up and the court is yours.
